sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF: Open-Source Code Generation LLM for ...
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF is a 1.5 billion parameter open-source code-generation model from Alibaba's Qwen team, pre-quantized in GGUF format for efficient local deployment. It supports up to 32,768 token context and is designed for code generation, reasoning, and fixing tasks.

sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF is an instruction-tuned, quantized coding LLM from Alibaba's Qwen team, trained on 5.5T tokens including synthetic code and text-code grounding. It fits the sweet spot for ops teams: small enough to run on a laptop or modest on-prem GPU, capable enough for code review automation, ticket triage, and custom knowledge-agent scaffolding.
